messages:
tara: T-minus 30 -> runtime v3.5 rollout tonight 22:00 UTC. Owners: alex, mike. Goal: zero-downtime canary then ramp. Quick checklist below — please ack if you're on runway.

Checklist:
- [ ] Canary 1% for 15m
- [ ] Canary validation: baseline latency, error-rate, cost delta
- [ ] Smoke: /health, sample prompt regression (see commands)
- [ ] Rollback toggle path: /ops/rollbacks/runtime/v3.5
- [ ] Observability: dashboards up 5m before
- [ ] On-call: mike (22:00–00:00 UTC)

Smoke commands:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.test/health
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: The quick brown fox"}'
```

If you see >2% errors or latency +50% -> abort and rollback.

alex: Ack. I'll run smoke and watch latency dashboards. I'll also flip canary to 5% if all green after 15m.

mike: On-call and reachable. Have rollback playbook bookmarked. If we need to revert, I'll coordinate infra rollback and route to standby pool.

jen: QA will run the regression prompt set (10 queries) ~21:30 UTC and post results in thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job created for 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z (job id runtime-rollout-30605). Canary percent initial: 1%.

tara: small note — we need feature-flag 'kv-cache-v2' enabled in canary only. alex please confirm config change is in canary config map.

alex: Confirmed. Adding this snippet to canary config:
```yaml
FEATURE_FLAGS:
  kv_cache_v2: true
```

jen: Regression results: 10/10 prompts matched baseline but QPS test shows 5% higher p95 -> fine for canary but watch.

mike: Ready. I'll keep a private channel open for rapid comms during the window.

tara: Great — everyone ack with :thumbsup: or 'go' when ready.

alex: :thumbsup: go

mike: go

jen: :thumbsup:

tara: Thanks all, scheduling set for 22:00 UTC. I'll post the post-rollout verify checklist in here once canary completes.
